name: PTRANS
recent: Perak Transit 近期持续进行股份回购，并公布2026财年第三季度每股0.125仙的中期股息，除息日为11月5日。公司同时出现董事与公司秘书变动，以及一名高管在10月多次增持股份。最新季度营收环比增长15.8%，但净利同比下滑23.8%。
notable: 宣布2026财年第三季度中期股息每股0.125仙，除息日11月5日，派发日11月25日。
10月30日宣布多项董事会委员会成员变动，包括Ng Wai Luen辞去审计委员会成员职务。
10月期间一名高管Cheong Mun Kwong多次在公开市场增持公司股份。
risks: 最新季度净利同比下滑23.8%，净利率从33.6%降至28.2%。
董事与公司秘书出现变动，包括审计委员会成员辞任。
公司持续进行股份回购，可能影响股本结构。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收5376万令吉，环比增长15.8%，同比增长9.4%；净利1515.8万令吉，环比下降2.9%，同比下降23.8%；净利率28.2%，低于上一季度的33.6%。

recent_en: Perak Transit has been conducting ongoing share buybacks and declared a third interim dividend of 0.125 sen per share for FY2026, with ex-date on 5 November. The company also saw changes in board committees and company secretary, while an officer acquired shares multiple times in October. Latest quarter revenue rose 15.8% QoQ but net profit fell 23.8% YoY.
notable_en: Declared a third interim dividend of 0.125 sen per share for FY2026, ex-date 5 November, payment date 25 November.
Announced multiple board committee changes on 30 October, including Ng Wai Luen's resignation as Audit Committee member.
An officer, Cheong Mun Kwong, acquired shares in the open market multiple times during October.
risks_en: Latest quarter net profit fell 23.8% YoY, with net margin declining from 33.6% to 28.2%.
Changes in board committees and company secretary, including resignation of an Audit Committee member.
Ongoing share buybacks may affect share capital structure.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM53.76 million, up 15.8% QoQ and 9.4% YoY; net profit was RM15.158 million, down 2.9% QoQ and 23.8% YoY; net margin was 28.2%, lower than 33.6% in the previous quarter.
